prediction: Changing only the batch dispatcher or attempt boundary changes the parallel-streaming regression while retaining decoder semantics.
evidence: Compact-record dispatcher has 868 assembly instructions in the parent and 1515 in the candidate. Instruction count is static code size, not executed work.
